prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one transparent game sprite atlas for SHITBIRD, 3 equal columns by 2 equal rows, landscape 1536x1024. The two supplied images are STYLE REFERENCES only: match West Cose's refined coastal surf-poster illustration and irreverent expressive gull, ink-green contours, warm ivory, muted teal and burnt orange, elegant hand-inked hatch shading with clear silhouettes that read at small size. Transparent background, six isolated cutout groups on a perfectly regular 3x2 grid, NO visible grid, no labels, no text, no scenery. Each cell 512x512, groups centered horizontally, feet/wheels ending at y=450 within their cell, at least 30px clear padding all sides. TOP ROW: left = beautiful side-view burnt-orange classic beach coupe facing right, cream roof with strapped surfboard, chrome trim, visible annoyed sunglassed driver; middle = full-body comic coastal tourist, big expressive face and moustache, orange bucket hat, teal Hawaiian shirt with ivory flowers, camera hanging at chest, beige shorts, sandals, looking upward with suspicion; right = smug bearded cafe patron in a cream cap and orange shirt sitting at a small round teal bistro table holding coffee, striped ivory/teal parasol above, chair and takeaway coffee. BOTTOM ROW: exact same three groups, same size, baseline, position, wardrobe and identity, AFTER a gull dropping: car has a small ivory splat on roof, driver angrily reaching one arm up; tourist has a small ivory splat on his hat, mouth open outraged, hands thrown up; cafe patron startled, leaning back with coffee lifted, small ivory splat on parasol. Keep the reactions comedic, crisp and readable. Treat this as one coordinated production sprite atlas. All six groups fully contained in their own cell; no overlap, backgrounds, ground planes, shadows extending past cells, rectangular backdrops or watermarks. Real alpha transparency, no checkerboard rendered in image.

Use case: compositing / production sprite atlas layout correction. EDIT this supplied six-sprite atlas only to fix its grid. Preserve all six lovely illustrated groups, their characters, objects, expressions, colors, ink details and truly transparent background. Output 1536x1024. Three EXACTLY equal columns of width512, two EXACTLY equal rows of height512. Column0 spans x0..511 and contains ONLY the car; column1 spans x512..1023 and contains ONLY the tourist; column2 spans x1024..1535 and contains ONLY cafe. Cars currently spill too far right: SHRINK BOTH CAR GROUPS to at most450 pixels wide, place centered at x256 entirely inside first column. Tourist centered x768, cafe centered x1280. Each object group within its cell with >=24px clear padding, all feet/wheels bottom aligned at localy464. Normal top row, angry bottom row. Exact same design / expressions; no new elements. NO overlapping cells. NO background / gradient / checkerboard / labels / text. Genuine alpha transparency. Every full cutout must fit its rectangle without clipping. This is a layout-only edit for a game engine to crop six512x512cells.
integration: WebP conversion preserves alpha. Renderer uses measured atlas regions; original generation retained.
